name: build_all_versions

description.what: Compiles the add-in once per version in the declared matrix.
description.when: Use when source has changed, or before packaging a release.
description.whenNot: Not for validating. It reports compiler errors, not submission findings.
requires: The .NET SDK on the build host

blastRadius: Overwrites build output for the named product. Reversible by rebuilding.
